findings.title: Five Men Plead Guilty for Their Roles in Global Digital Asset Investment Scam Conspiracy Resulting in Theft of More than $36.9 Million from Victims
findings.summary_md: Five men pleaded guilty for their roles in laundering more than $36.9 million from victims of an international digital asset investment scam carried out from scam centers in Cambodia. The conspirators induced U.S. victims to transfer funds to accounts controlled by co-conspirators, moving the money through U.S. shell companies, international bank accounts, and digital asset wallets. Over $36.9 million went from U.S. bank accounts controlled by co-conspirators to a single account at Deltec Bank in the Bahamas opened in the name of Axis Digital Limited, then converted to Tether and sent to a wallet controlled in Cambodia.

findings.title: California Man Sentenced for Role in Global Digital Asset Investment Scam Conspiracy Resulting in Theft of More than $36.9M from Victims
findings.summary_md: Shengsheng He was sentenced to 51 months in federal prison for laundering more than $36.9 million from victims in an international digital asset investment scam carried out from scam centers in Cambodia. The court ordered $26,867,242.44 in restitution to victims. He was a former co-owner of Bahamas-based Axis Digital Limited and pleaded guilty to conspiracy to operate an unlicensed money transmitting business.

findings.title: Chinese National Sentenced to Prison for Role in Crypto Scam Targeting Americans
findings.summary_md: Chinese national Jingliang Su was sentenced to 46 months in prison for laundering more than $36.9 million from victims in a digital asset investment conspiracy carried out from scam centers in Cambodia. The court ordered $26,867,242.44 in restitution. Su pleaded guilty in June 2025 to one count of conspiracy to operate an illegal money transmitting business.

findings.title: Chinese National Extradited for Alleged Role in Multimillion-Dollar Cryptocurrency Scam Targeting U.S. Citizens
findings.summary_md: Zheng Zhao, 44, a Chinese national, was arraigned in the Central District of California after being extradited from the Netherlands for his alleged role in an international cryptocurrency investment conspiracy carried out from scam centers in Cambodia that targeted U.S. citizens. The government identified 174 U.S. victims. Zhao was charged in August 2025 with conspiracy to commit money laundering and faces up to 20 years in prison.
